title: True or False (1 point each)
instructions: Select True or False for each statement.

questions.question: In C#, curly braces can group multiple statements into the body of an if statement.
The string literal "42" and the integer literal 42 have the same data type in C#.
A variable declared as int can store a whole-number value such as -3.
The condition score >= 10 can be true when score is exactly 10.
An else block runs when the condition of its matching if statement is true.
